+"""Split branching skeletons into simple brush strokes."""
+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import deque
+import numpy as np
+from scipy import ndimage as ndi
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+from plan import neighbors_map,simplify_route
+
+OUT=Path('/app/output')
+z=np.load(OUT/'target_analysis.npz');skel=z['skel'];dist=z['dist']
+lab,n=ndi.label(skel,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
+adj=neighbors_map(skel)
+
+def split(k,ntry=6000):
+    pts={p for p in adj if lab[p]==k}
+    root=next(p for p in pts if len(adj[p])==1)
+    parent={root:None};q=deque([root])
+    while q:
+        a=q.popleft()
+        for b in adj[a]:
+            if b in pts and b not in parent:
+                parent[b]=a;q.append(b)
+    children={p:[] for p in pts}
+    for p,pa in parent.items():
+        if pa is not None:children[pa].append(p)
+    terminals=[root]+[p for p in pts if not children[p]]
+    if len(terminals)%2: terminals.append(root)
+    def path_between(a,b):
+        aa=[];c=a
+        while c is not None:aa.append(c);c=parent[c]
+        aset=set(aa);bb=[];c=b
+        while c not in aset:bb.append(c);c=parent[c]
+        return aa[:aa.index(c)+1]+bb[::-1]
+    unique=list(dict.fromkeys(terminals));N=len(unique)
+    paths={};bits={};lens={}
+    idx={p:i for i,p in enumerate(pts)}
+    for i in range(N):
+        for j in range(i+1,N):
+            path=path_between(unique[i],unique[j]);key=(i,j)
+            paths[key]=path;lens[key]=len(path)
+            bb=0
+            for p in path:bb|=1<<idx[p]
+            bits[key]=bb
+    rng=np.random.default_rng(100+k)
+    best=(-1,-1,None)
+    for rep in range(ntry):
+        order=rng.permutation(len(terminals))
+        pairs=[];allbits=0;length=0
+        valid=True
+        for a,b in zip(order[::2],order[1::2]):
+            a=unique.index(terminals[a]);b=unique.index(terminals[b])
+            if a==b:valid=False;break
+            key=tuple(sorted((a,b)))
+            pairs.append((a,b));allbits |= bits[key];length+=lens[key]
+        if not valid:continue
+        coverage=allbits.bit_count()
+        score=(coverage,-length)
+        if score>best[:2]:best=(coverage,-length,pairs)
+        if coverage==len(pts) and rep>=1000:break
+    if best[2] is None:raise RuntimeError('no matching')
+    out=[]
+    for a,b in best[2]:
+        path=paths[tuple(sorted((a,b)))]
+        if path[0]!=unique[a]:path=path[::-1]
+        # Press the tuft first at the wider end so initial splay stays in ink.
+        if dist[path[0]]<dist[path[-1]]:path=path[::-1]
+        out.append(simplify_route(path,dist))
+    print('component',k,'terminals',len(terminals),'coverage',best[0],len(pts),'length',-best[1],
+          'segments',[len(a) for a in out])
+    return out
+
+if __name__=='__main__':

+    colors=['#ff0000','#00aa00','#0000ff','#ffff00','#00ffff','#ff00ff','#ff8800']
+    for k in (4,5,6,7):
+        for j,a in enumerate(split(k)):
+            np.save(OUT/f'seg_{k}_{j}.npy',a)
+            draw.line([(float(u),float(v)) for v,u,r in a],fill=colors[j],width=2)
+            v,u,r=a[0];draw.ellipse((u-4,v-4,u+4,v+4),fill=colors[j])
